findings.issue_category: missing key policy / overly permissive default
findings.description: No key_policy is defined for this KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy which grants full access (kms:*) to the root account and, via IAM policies, potentially all IAM principals in the account. For an audit trail key this violates least privilege since any principal with broad IAM permissions could manage or use the key to decrypt sensitive audit logs.

The resource does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual rotation of the KMS key material is disabled by default, increasing the risk associated with long-term use of a single key for encrypting sensitive audit data.
